decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for hot food takeaway/restaurant purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 11.30am - 23.00pm.
Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 8am-8pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The scheme of ventilation approved under Condition 5 shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the takeaway/restuarant shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 9 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of refuse and recycling facilities have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The refuse/ recycling arrangements shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the premises hereby permitted is occupied

Condition : 10 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. 2006/0521/15/C and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
description: Change of use from (car showroom) sui generis to A5 (hot food take-away) incorporating a new shop front
